purpose: Autonomous source lifecycle registry. This file tracks policy states for candidate and live sources without requiring routine manual source selection.

state_model.discovered: Candidate source found by search or discovery but not yet eligible for ingestion.
state_model.probation: Candidate source may be sampled with strict limits and source rules.
state_model.active: Source is eligible for normal Daily Radar ingestion.
state_model.degraded: Source remains known but has repeated health, density or quality issues.
state_model.suspended: Source is temporarily excluded by policy until health or quality recovers.
state_model.rejected: Source failed policy and should not be retried unless discovery evidence changes.
